## Valmont Announces Timing of Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Release and Conference Call


September 29, 2026


[PDF Version](https://investors.valmont.com/node/16576/pdf)


OMAHA, Neb.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Sep. 29, 2026-- Valmont® Industries, Inc. (NYSE: VMI), a global leader that provides products and solutions to support vital infrastructure and advance agricultural productivity, will release its third quarter 2026 financial results before the market opens on Tuesday, October 20, 2026.


Following the earnings release, Avner M. Applbaum, President and Chief Executive Officer, and John Schwietz, Chief Financial Officer, will host a webcast and conference call at 8:00 a.m. CT on Tuesday, October 20, 2026 to discuss the financial results.


To participate in the live call, you may dial +1 877.407.6184 or +1 201.389.0877 (no Conference ID needed), or connect via webcast using this link:[Valmont Industries 3Q 2026 Earnings Conference Call.](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fevent.webcasts.com%2Fstarthere.jsp%3Fei%3D1737664%26tp_key%3Dad98821025&esheet=54612080&newsitemid=20260929695871&lan=en-US&anchor=Valmont+Industries+3Q+2026+Earnings+Conference+Call.&index=1&md5=20b7d61bcdb6a984e932544fdb172a40) A slide presentation will simultaneously be available for download on the[Investors](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.valmont.com%2F&esheet=54612080&newsitemid=20260929695871&lan=en-US&anchor=Investors&index=2&md5=b1f24584494a5cb4a5bd0458d9a526fe) page of[valmont.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.valmont.com%2F&esheet=54612080&newsitemid=20260929695871&lan=en-US&anchor=valmont.com&index=3&md5=70794c65eb71e9e94c824711725bde8c) . A replay of the event can be accessed three hours after the call at the above link or by telephone at +1 877.660.6853 or +1 201.612.7415. Please use access code 13756346. The replay will be available through 10:59 p.m. CT on October 27, 2026.


**About Valmont Industries, Inc.**


For more than 80 years, Valmont has been a global leader that provides products and solutions to support vital infrastructure and advance agricultural productivity. We are committed to customer-focused innovation that delivers lasting value. Learn more about how we’re *Conserving Resources.
